strengths: Washer in the bathroom or on the balcony, drip conflicts, underwear hung inward, night hanging before a 7 a.m. commute—these are local, not tourism copy.
nureta mama as a small household failure (dishes in the sink, not a sacred rule) would make Japanese readers nod.
Futon airing is treated as moisture and bulk, not as a sun-worship ritual.

issues.location: How Japanese Households Treat Drying as a Daily Task — “School and home still teach a mild preference for airing things.”
issues.problem: Sounds like a curriculum claim. Locals learned this from weather and mold, not from a school subject called laundry.
issues.suggestion: Attribute the preference to humid summers and closet smell, not to “school still teaches.”
